name: Network packet capture combined with SSL keylogfile decryption
topic: Network packet capture combined with SSL keylogfile decryption
description: Network packet capture combined with SSL keylogfile decryption -- a hard-tier forensics challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Network packet capture combined with SSL keylogfile decryption"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is a double layer: hex -> base64 -> XOR. Unwind both layers and recover the 4-byte XOR key.
